info.description: Gateway for jobs, reactions, keyword dictionaries, profiles, LLM admin, and sources.

status.description: Static status marker; always "ok" when the process is serving.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the response, for staleness checks in monitors.

id.description: Primary key (bigint serialized as a string).

externalId.description: External posting id on the source site.

postedAt.description: Posting date on the source site (ISO 8601).

firstSeenAt.description: When the job was first seen by a scraper (ISO 8601).

lastSeenAt.description: When the job was last seen by a scraper (ISO 8601).

matchScore.description: Latest match score for the active profile, if any.

currentReaction.description: Current reaction stage for the active profile, if any.

total.description: Total number of items matching the filter.

highFit.description: Matching jobs scoring >= 80 (absent match counts as 0).

inMotion.description: Matching jobs whose latest reaction is applied, interview, or offer.

unreviewed.description: Matching jobs with no reaction recorded yet.
